pivot: the build pad's centre on its top surface; fits a 1 x 1 pad and a tower up to ~0.45 radius and 1.75 high (scale to the tower)

growth.shape_key: Retracted (1 = flat on the pad, 0 = grown)
growth.color_attribute: Growth: R = growth order 0..1 (pad first, tips last), G = jitter for a ragged front
growth.recipe: grow over ~1 s: blend shape 100 -> 0 while a clip threshold on Growth.R runs 0 -> 1; burn away: reverse with an emission flash
